tools.name: query_plantings
tools.description: List the user's plantings (what is planted, where, when, how, current status). Use when the user asks what they planted, when something was sown/transplanted, or what's growing in a bed.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search the garden log: watering, fertilizing, transplanting, pruning, pest sightings, treatments, frost damage, notes. Use when the user asks when they last did something or what happened in the garden.

tools.name: get_harvests
tools.description: List harvests with per-plant totals. Use when the user asks what/how much they harvested.

tools.name: list_beds
tools.description: List the garden's beds: name, type (outdoor_bed/raised_bed/greenhouse/grow_light_shelf/pot), dimensions in cm, notes, and how many active plantings each holds. Use to see what beds exist and where there may be room.

tools.name: get_bed_layout
tools.description: Read a bed's layout grid: the bed's dimensions (cm) plus each placed planting's footprint (xCm, yCm from the bed's top-left; wCm × hCm), and any active plantings not yet placed. Use to reason about space — e.g. "is there 60 cm free at the front of Bed 2?". Positions are written by place_planting.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.description: Current weather at the garden (station if connected, else forecast) plus per-bed soil moisture/temperature. Use for "how is the garden right now / should I water".

tools.name: get_soil_readings
tools.description: Latest soil moisture % and soil temperature per bed, with bed names. Use for watering/sowing decisions.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: 7-day forecast for the garden with overnight-low frost alerts. Use for planting timing, frost protection, watering plans.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Daily weather history for the garden: min/max temp, rain, growing degree days (base 10 °C) with a cumulative total. Use for "how warm/wet has it been" and growth-progress questions.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Upcoming sowing/transplant windows computed from the user's plant catalog and the garden's frost dates, plus zone, frost dates, and any due care tasks (watering/fertilizing, with a rain-skip hint). Use for "what should I plant/start/transplant and when" and "what care is due".

tools.name: log_event
tools.description: Record something the user did or observed: watered, fertilized, transplanted, pruned, pest sighting, treatment, frost damage, or a note. Attach it to a plant's active planting via `plant`, to a bed via `bed`, or garden-wide with neither. If both plant and bed are given, the event attaches to the pla

tools.name: record_harvest
tools.description: Record a harvest, e.g. "I picked 2 kg of cucumbers" or "2 lb of tomatoes". Resolves the plant's active planting automatically. Pounds and ounces are stored as grams.

tools.name: add_planting
tools.description: Record that the user planted/sowed something: creates the plant in their catalog if new and the planting in the named bed. Passing variety replaces the variety stored on an existing plant with the same name.

tools.name: log_curing
tools.description: Record that a harvested crop has finished curing (or dismiss the reminder). Use when the gardener says they've cured, dried, trimmed or stored a crop like garlic, onions or herbs.

tools.name: create_bed
tools.description: Add a garden bed. `type` is one of outdoor_bed (in-ground), raised_bed, greenhouse, grow_light_shelf, pot. Dimensions (lengthCm/widthCm/heightCm) are optional. Use when the user wants a new bed or planting area.

tools.name: update_bed
tools.description: Change an existing bed's name, type, or dimensions. Identify the bed by its current name. Use when the user wants to rename a bed, change its type, or set/adjust its dimensions.

tools.name: set_care_schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring care schedule (water/fertilize/custom). Scope it to a plant (its active planting), a bed, or the whole garden. Recurrence is EITHER everyDays (e.g. 3) OR weekdays (e.g. ['monday','thursday']). Use when the user wants a repeating watering/feeding reminder. Optionally end it on a da

tools.name: update_planting
tools.description: Change a planting's status (active/finished/failed), notes, quantity, transplant date, variety, or MOVE it to another bed (pass bed with the target bed's name — history stays attached; any layout position is cleared, re-place with place_planting). Identify the planting by plant name or plantingId.

tools.name: delete_planting
tools.description: Remove a planting from the garden. Siltwell archives it: it disappears from the app and from these tools, and its care schedules stop. Its harvests, events and photos stay stored, but the app has no way to restore it. Identify by plant name or plantingId. Use when the user says to delete/remove a pl

tools.name: delete_bed
tools.description: Remove a bed from the garden. Siltwell archives it: it leaves the bed lists in the app and in these tools, its care schedules stop, and planned plantings queued for it are skipped. Past weather history still shows its name. The app has no way to restore it. Blocked while the bed has active plantings

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Turn off a recurring care schedule (stops its reminders). Identify it by scheduleId, or by scope — plant (its active planting), bed, or garden-wide (neither) — optionally narrowed by type (water/fertilize/custom). Use when the user says to stop a watering/feeding reminder.

tools.name: update_harvest
tools.description: Correct a logged harvest — the most-recent harvest of a plant (by name) or a specific harvestId. Edit quantity, unit, notes, or the date. Use when the user says a harvest they recorded was wrong.

tools.name: place_planting
tools.description: Place or move a planting on its bed's layout grid — set its position (xCm, yCm measured from the bed's top-left corner) and footprint (wCm × hCm) in centimeters. Identify the planting by plant name or plantingId. Use when the user wants to arrange, position, or move a plant within its bed. For a pla

tools.name: list_planned_plantings
tools.description: List the garden's succession plan — future plantings queued for a bed that haven't been sown yet (only status='planned'; done/skipped entries are omitted). Use when the user asks what's coming up next, what they've planned to plant, or wants to review their succession plan. For plantings already in

tools.name: add_planned_planting
tools.description: Queue a future planting for a bed as part of a succession plan — it is NOT yet sown (use add_planting for something the user already planted). Use when the user wants to plan ahead, e.g. "plan to plant more carrots in Bed 2 on August 15".

tools.name: update_planned_planting
tools.description: Update a queued succession-plan entry: change its status (planned/done/skipped), reschedule its targetDate, or adjust quantity/notes. Identify it by id (from list_planned_plantings). Use when the user sows a planned planting (mark status done), decides to skip it, or wants to reschedule/adjust it.

tools.name: delete_planned_planting
tools.description: Remove an entry from the succession plan outright (a queued future planting that hasn't been sown). This is a hard delete, not recoverable — for a planting already sown/growing, use delete_planting instead. Identify it by id (from list_planned_plantings).

tools.name: get_season_plan
tools.description: Compute the garden's rest-of-season planting schedule: every bed's next crops, chained forward to the effective first frost, deconflicted across beds with crop rotation and curated sow windows. Returns a PROPOSAL only — nothing is written; use add_planned_planting to accept a row into the succession

tools.name: lookup_frost_dates
tools.description: Average last spring frost, average first fall frost and hardiness zone for any place, from 10 years of weather records. Works without a Siltwell account. Dates are MM-DD. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_plan returns the garden's zone and frost dates, with the frost dates adjusted for its mi

tools.name: lookup_planting_windows
tools.description: When to start seeds indoors, plant out, and sow for a fall harvest at any place, crop by crop, with the days left to sow today. Works without a Siltwell account. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Without crops, it returns the 30 crops with the soonest next step; pass crops to see others. For the signed-in user'

tools.name: lookup_growing_season
tools.description: Frost-free season length and seasonal growing degree days at any place, and whether heat-loving crops get enough heat to ripen. Works without a Siltwell account. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_plan returns the microclimate-adjusted frost dates that bound its season, and get_history returns

tools.name: lookup_frost_risk
tools.description: Forecast lows for the next 7 days at any place and the nights at risk of frost. Each frost night is dated by the morning its low falls on, so protect plants the evening before that date. Works without a Siltwell account. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_planned_plantings · Private data: log_event, record_harvest, add_planting, log_curing, lookup_frost_dates · Public sink: get_season_plan · Destructive: delete_planting, delete_bed, delete_schedule, delete_planned_planting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_planned_plantings · Private data: log_event, record_harvest, add_planting, log_curing, lookup_frost_dates · Public sink: get_season_plan · Destructive: delete_planting, delete_bed, delete_schedule, delete_planned_planting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
